sections.heading: Design History
sections.wikitext:
Fireblade initially was designed as a smoke-themed ninja. Due to the similarities to [[Shinobi]] in the rough sketch, the original design was scrapped to redesign this Titan as a fire-themed ninja. Fireblade then was given red clothing, fiery eyes, and flames on his sword. As a ninja, he was designed to be fast and acrobatic instead of having raw power. {{source|Huntik.com/Secret_Files|Huntik.com}}

full_text:
Fireblade is a ninja-like Yama-Titan who uses its stealth and fiery abilities in battle.

== History ==
A Fireblade used its acrobatic skills to jump over an allied Brahe Titan during a skirmish. [SAS-031]

== Abilities ==
Fireblade is a very skilled martial artist, knowing fighting styles of the ninja and being incredibly acrobatic. In addition to that he also wields two very sharp blades. His body is comprised of flames so he can eject flames at will.

== Design History ==
Fireblade initially was designed as a smoke-themed ninja. Due to the similarities to Shinobi in the rough sketch, the original design was scrapped to redesign this Titan as a fire-themed ninja. Fireblade then was given red clothing, fiery eyes, and flames on his sword. As a ninja, he was designed to be fast and acrobatic instead of having raw power. [Huntik.com/Secret_Files]

'''Fireblade''' is a ninja-like [[Yama-Titan]] who uses its stealth and fiery abilities in battle.

== History ==
A Fireblade used its acrobatic skills to jump over an allied [[Brahe]] Titan during a skirmish. {{source|SAS-031}}

== Abilities ==
Fireblade is a very skilled martial artist, knowing fighting styles of the ninja and being incredibly acrobatic. In addition to that he also wields two very sharp blades. His body is comprised of flames so he can eject flames at will.

== Design History ==
Fireblade initially was designed as a smoke-themed ninja. Due to the similarities to [[Shinobi]] in the rough sketch, the original design was scrapped to redesign this Titan as a fire-themed ninja. Fireblade then was given red clothing, fiery eyes, and flames on his sword. As a ninja, he was designed to be fast and acrobatic instead of having raw power. {{source|Huntik.com/Secret_Files|Huntik.com}}
